title: Software Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Design skills is a plus. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills Ability to develop Software with Clean Code and SOLID principles Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2+years Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of AI Statement At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Perform environment setup and configuration, along with proactive monitoring and maintenance. Evaluate the performance of stored procedures, identify time- and resource-consuming areas, and provide input to application developers to address them. Analyze access patterns and propose the best combination of indexes, constraints, foreign keys, and queries. Proactively identify technical opportunities and enhancements while addressing major incidents in a timely manner. Collaboration & Delivery Support the development of long- and short-term requirements for database administration and design. Working understanding of technologies including MariaDB/MySQL, NoSQL, and PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.). Working technical knowledge and experience with current Linux operating systems. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Proficient in relational databases, backup, and recovery. Comfortable with shell scripting and related scripting procedures. Preferred Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with MySQL; PostgreSQL is a plus but optional. Experience with Aurora/RDS, ProxySQL, and Percona / PMM / Grafana. Knowledge of Galera cluster for clustering, scalability, and replication-based availability. Experience working with application development teams, including query review and GitLab. Strong exposure to Linux resource and process monitoring, and scripting basics (shell, Python, or similar). Key Competencies Analytical & Problem-Solving Mindset Database Reliability & Performance Tuning Automation-First Approach Ownership & Incident Response Collaboration with Development Teams Technical Environment Databases: MariaDB, MySQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra), Aurora/RDS Clustering & Availability: Galera Cluster, Replication Monitoring: Percona, PMM, Grafana Proxy/Access: ProxySQL Scripting: Shell, Perl, Python Operating Systems: Linux Version Control: GitLab

description: QA Engineer Key Responsibilities Own whether the platform is safe to release — the automated suite, the manual passes automation cannot replace, and the judgement about what a failing test actually means Build and keep the end-to-end suite in Playwright across the journeys that matter — a patient booked, registered, seen, billed, dispensed to and reported on — and keep it fast and trustworthy enough that nobody is tempted to ignore a red build Write the test plan for each module from what the hospital does rather than from what the screen shows, with the Business Analyst and the module owner in the room Own the regression pack that runs before every release, and grow it every time something escapes Run beta: put each release in front of the hospital's own people on migrated data, log what they find so it can be reproduced, and close it before the next release starts Be the person who says a release is not ready, and be right often enough that it carries weight Where Testing Is Mandatory Money — every path that produces a bill, a discount, a refund or a day-end total, including the ones that fail halfway through Stock — batch, expiry, issue and return, and the concurrent case where two counters sell the last strip Clinical safety — allergy and interaction checks, dose limits by age and weight, critical values, and every alert that must reach a human Access — that one hospital cannot see another's data, and that a role cannot do what it should not Integrations — a laboratory result from a real analyser, an image from a real modality, an ABHA created against the real sandbox; a mock proves the code, not the hospital Test the failure paths as seriously as the happy ones; the happy path is the one everybody already tried Beta, Parallel Run and Go-Live Turn the acceptance scripts into something the hospital's own staff can run and sign, on their own migrated data, in the beta environment Design the parallel run: what is entered in both systems, what is reconciled daily, and what "the numbers match" means for registrations, bills, collections, dispensing and reports Be on the floor through cutover and hypercare, where the real testing happens, and bring what you see back into the suite Own test data: realistic, safe, and reproducible, including the awkward records that break things — the duplicate patient, the expired batch, the refund after a partial payment Working With the Team Sit in on specification work early, because the cheapest defect is the one caught while the specification is still a paragraph Keep every defect described so that someone who was not there can reproduce it — steps, data, environment, what was expected, what happened Track what escaped and why, and bring it to the retrospective rather than to an individual Pair with engineers on the automated checks that live beside the code, so testing is not a gate at the end but a habit along the way Tech Stack Playwright · TypeScript · pytest · Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · SQL · REST · OpenAPI · GitHub Actions · Docker · HL7 v2 · FHIR · ABDM We build in Python on FastAPI with React in front of it, on Amazon Web Services, and we test it with Playwright and pytest. the OpenAPI schema is the contract, and tests are written to it Database verification — PostgreSQL and SQL good enough to prove in the database what the screen claims, and to spot the migration that silently rounded a rupee Continuous integration — GitHub Actions; the suite runs on every pull request, and a red build blocks a merge Environments — Docker-based environments for development, beta and UAT, each with its own reproducible data set Performance — load testing at peak outpatient volume with k6 or Locust, and the judgement to know which number matters Integration test beds — HL7 v2 messages from analysers over MLLP, DICOM modality worklist and PACS, and the ABDM sandbox for ABHA creation and consent Defect and test management — a shared tracker visible to the hospital, with a published severity and response standard What we need you to have used in production Playwright, Cypress or Selenium on a system people depended on — writing maintainable tests, not recording brittle ones A programming language , enough to write helpers, fixtures and data builders; title: Software Development Engineer
description: Job ID 73588 Category Enterprise Technology Location Chennai, India Work Type Hybrid As a Senior SAP ABAP & Fiori Developer, you will design, develop, enhance, and optimize SAP applications and reporting solutions across SAP S/4HANA. You will work across the application stack, developing SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 user experiences as well as backend solutions using ABAP, CDS Views, ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP), OData services, and modern SAP development frameworks. The successful candidate will bring strong hands-on SAP engineering experience, an understanding of S/4HANA development principles, and the ability to troubleshoot complex functional and technical problems. You will collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and engineers in an agile product environment to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. SAP Fiori and User Experience Development Extend, configure, and customize standard SAP Fiori applications and Fiori Elements, including List Reports, Analytical List Pages, and Overview Pages. Develop custom SAP Fiori/SAPUI5 applications using MVC architecture, JavaScript, XML, HTML5, and CSS. Configure and support SAP Fiori Launchpad functionality, including catalogs, roles, spaces, and pages. Design, develop, and optimize OData v2 and v4 services using SAP Gateway, CDS-based services, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP). Apply SAP Fiori design principles to deliver intuitive and consistent user experiences. Advanced ABAP and Reporting Development Design and develop high-performance analytical and operational solutions using ABAP on SAP HANA, CDS Views, and AMDP. Develop scalable backend solutions using modern ABAP syntax and object-oriented ABAP. Build CDS Views using appropriate annotations, associations, access controls, and reusable data models. Apply HANA code-pushdown techniques to improve application and reporting performance. Maintain and modernize existing ABAP applications and reports, including ALV, classical, and interactive reports, where required. Perform performance analysis and optimization using tools such as SQL Trace (ST05), ABAP Runtime Analysis (SAT), and ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC). Troubleshoot complex application, integration, and data-performance issues. Apply clean-core principles and SAP S/4HANA development standards when designing extensions and custom solutions. Agile Collaboration and Engineering Quality Work collaboratively with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and engineering teams to clarify requirements and refine user stories. Participate in estimation, sprint planning, technical design discussions, and solution reviews. Apply automated testing and Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices where appropriate. Participate in peer code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing activities. Support continuous integration and continuous delivery practices for SAP development. Create maintainable technical documentation and contribute to engineering standards. Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve application performance, maintainability, and reliability. Required Qualifications and Experience 6+ years of hands-on SAP development experience with strong expertise in ABAP and object-oriented ABAP. Hands-on experience developing solutions on SAP S/4HANA. Strong experience with SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 application development. Demonstrated experience developing CDS Views and HANA-optimized ABAP solutions. Experience with ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP), SQLScript, or Table Functions. Hands-on experience developing and consuming OData services. Experience with SAP Gateway and modern SAP application development approaches such as RAP. Experience troubleshooting and optimizing ABAP, SQL, and CDS performance. Experience with SAP development environments such as Eclipse with ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and SAP Business Application Studio (BAS). Understanding of SAP transport and software lifecycle management practices. Technical Skills SAP Backend Development ABAP Object-oriented ABAP ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) CDS Views AMDP SQLScript and Table Functions SAP Frontend Development SAP Fiori SAPUI5 Fiori Elements JavaScript HTML5 CSS XML and JSON Integration SAP Gateway OData v2/v4 Remote Function Call (RFC) Business Application Programming Interfaces (BAPIs) ALE/IDoc integration Development and Quality Tools Eclipse with ABAP Development Tools SAP Business Application Studio ABAP Unit Git or gCTS SAP transport management ATC, SAT, and ST05 performance and quality tools Professional Skills Strong analytical and structured problem-solving abilities. Ability to diagnose complex application, integration, and performance issues. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborative working style with experience in code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. Ability to adapt to evolving SAP technologies and development practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Experience with SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). Experience with SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud. Familiarity with enterprise reporting and analytics technologies such as Google BigQuery, Qlik Sense, or Microsoft Power BI. Experience with SAP BTP Integration Suite or Extension Suite capabilities. Relevant SAP certifications in ABAP development, SAP S/4HANA, or SAP Fiori/SAPUI5. Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or other complex enterprise environments. Familiarity with cloud-native development and continuous integration/continuous delivery practices. #LI-MF2

title: Software Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Responsibilities Responsible for software development activities using C# / Angular/ C++ Good debugging skills using C#/Angular/ C++ Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of inspector software Participate in end to end product development lifecycle activities Acquire knowledge of key use cases in defect inspection using LS&SWIFT tools Collaborate with teams across different geographical zones to develop / deliver software solutions Being flexible with work timings, attending to technical discussions with business team/peer teams across the globe Work with team leads and groups including systems/hardware, marketing, applications and manufacturing on all aspects of software project including requirement definition, design, development, deployment, support and service Understand and apply software development best practices Travel to other KLA sites and customer sites on a needed basis Qualifications Studied BE/BTech with 2+ yrs of exp (OR) MS/MCA/MTech Strong in programming fundamentals, .NET and C#/C++/Angular with good software design exposure. Design skills is a plus. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills Ability to develop Software with Clean Code and SOLID principles Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2+years Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of AI Statement At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
